tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List the company's projects with status, dates and progress. Use first when the user hasn't said which project.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Keyword search across projects, tasks, contacts, files, RFIs, punch items and indexed documents.

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: A project's tasks with dates, status, % complete, float, critical flag and assigned subs. Filter by a date window or task name.

tools.name: critical_path
tools.description: The chain of tasks that drives the project's finish date (zero or negative float), in order.

tools.name: float_report
tools.description: Tasks with little or negative float (slack) — how many workdays each can slip before it delays the finish.

tools.name: schedule_delays
tools.description: Why the schedule moved: recent date changes with who/why (delay reason), plus baseline and target variance.

tools.name: sub_status
tools.description: Which subcontractors are booked on which tasks and whether they confirmed, declined, proposed a new date or haven't answered.

tools.name: budget_status
tools.description: Budget vs. actual by cost code: revised budget, committed, actual, projected, variance, contract, billed and projected profit.

tools.name: list_rfis
tools.description: RFIs for a project with status, ball-in-court, due date, overdue flag and the answer if any.

tools.name: daily_logs
tools.description: Daily logs in a date range: work performed, crew counts, delays, weather and notes.

tools.name: punch_list
tools.description: Punch, issue and to-do items for a project with status, trade, assignee and due date.

tools.name: list_submittals
tools.description: Submittals with status, spec section, required-by task and date warnings (approval too late for lead time).

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Find passages in the project's indexed specs, drawings and RFIs that answer a question. Returns excerpts with page numbers to cite.

tools.name: schedule_risks
tools.description: Rule-based risk list for the next 7 days: late work, unconfirmed or declined subs, weather on outdoor work, negative float, overdue RFIs and punch items.

tools.name: propose_schedule_changes
tools.description: Propose edits to EXISTING tasks (move dates, change duration, set progress/status, add or remove links, add a task). Nothing changes until a person approves the proposal. Describe the change in `request`; optionally give exact `edits`.

tools.name: draft_rfi
tools.description: Draft an RFI (subject, question, suggested solution) from notes, using the project's specs and schedule. Saved as a proposal; a person approves it to create the RFI as a draft.

tools.name: apply_proposal
tools.description: Apply a pending proposal (schedule change, RFI draft, punch items). ONLY call this after the user has explicitly approved that exact proposal; pass confirm=true. Unless the API key allows direct apply, this returns an approval link the user opens in Construction Company Software to approve it.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
